description: This file defines the sysinfo class for FreeBSD, extending a common BSD class, and provides methods related to system information such as network statistics, system ticks, and memory details.

classes.name: sysinfo
classes.description: Class providing FreeBSD-specific system information functionalities, extending bsd_common.

methods.name: sysinfo
methods.description: Constructor method initializing regex patterns and setting up the class.

methods.name: get_sys_ticks
methods.description: Calculates and returns the system uptime in seconds.

methods.name: network
methods.description: Retrieves and processes network interface statistics using netstat.

methods.name: distroicon
methods.description: Returns the filename for the FreeBSD system icon.

methods.name: memory_additional
methods.description: Enhances memory results with cached, active, and buffer memory details.
